title: WoW Forever Horde Leveling System & Guide Repository
intro: Welcome to the master source of truth for the 9-character Horde leveling, profession, and trade ecosystem in **World of Warcraft: Forever**.

skin.name: Skinning

milestones.desc: Ruined Leather Scraps from starting-zone beasts (keep them: 7c at a vendor, about 46c on the auction house), Light Leather from about level 10 beasts in The Barrens.
Medium leather in the south Barrens, Stonetalon and Ashenvale.
Heavy leather in Stranglethorn, Arathi and Desolace.
Thick, then rugged leather in Feralas, Un'Goro and the Plaguelands.

skin.nodesNote: Skill needed, from Classic: not checked in Forever. Skinning a beast needs skill 5 x its level (up to level 10: any skill).

herb.name: Herbalism

milestones.desc: Peacebloom, Silverleaf, Earthroot.
Mageroyal, Briarthorn, Bruiseweed, Stranglekelp.
Wild Steelbloom, Kingsblood, Liferoot, Goldthorn, Khadgar's Whisker.

tips: Tauren in Forever: Cultivation no longer gives +15 Herbalism. Use it on a nearby herb node and a bonus herb node grows that anyone can pick, even without Herbalism. Your level must be at least the herb's skill divided by 5.
Camp object: Incense Candle at skill 20 (Intellect).
herb.nodesNote: Skill needed, from Classic: not checked in Forever. Swiftthistle has no node of its own: it comes with Mageroyal (50) and Briarthorn (70).

mine.name: Mining

milestones.desc: Copper ore. Smelt copper bars. Loot each node fully: it can take several hits but gives at most 1 skill point.
Tin and silver ore. Smelt bronze. Keep rare finds (Pyrite, Bauxite, Pitchblende): Engineering and other crafts want them.
Iron and gold ore in Desolace, Arathi and Stranglethorn.
Mithril, truesilver, then thorium in Tanaris, Un'Goro, Felwood and the Plaguelands. The beta caps Mining at 225 for now: do not buy materials for 300 yet.

mine.nodesNote: Skill needed, from Classic; the same numbers in a Forever mining video (Dave The Gamer, 2026-10). Not checked in game.
tips: Forever: Mining makes sharpening stones (RestedXP tip, 2026-10-12): a melee leveler trains Mining and buys a Mining Pick early to sharpen its weapon. Not checked.

tail.name: Tailoring

milestones.desc: Linen bolts and belts.
learn: Linen Bag: now learnable at skill 5. One for every character.

Week 1: make Linen Bags instead of Linen Belts if they still give skill points (orange, yellow or green name): use them for your characters. Sell them only if the Money tab shows a profit: a vendor sells a 6-slot bag for 5s, and with beta prices (linen 99c) a bag costs about 6s 24c to make. When bags do not pay, make cloth gear to disenchant for Enchanting (Brown Linen Pants method).
Faction Banner (camp object) at skill 20.
skip: Linen shirts and robes to sell: they sell for almost nothing.
milestones.mats: About 115 Linen Cloth, 28 Coarse Thread, 60 Wool Cloth.

milestones.desc: Needs Tailoring 50 and level 10.

levelWith.note: Silk route: 100-120 Bolt of Silk Cloth, 120-125 Azure Silk Hood.
Needs Elixir of Wisdom from an alchemist. Silk route: Azure Silk Hood to 135, Formal White Shirt to 140, Bolt of Mageweave to 150.

learn: Woolen Bag (8-slot) at skill 50.
skip: Woolen gear to sell: players rarely buy it.
milestones.mats: About 400 Wool Cloth (as bolts), 230 Fine Thread, 11 Gray Dye, 52 Elixir of Wisdom.

milestones.desc: Needs Tailoring 125, level 20 and 50 silver (Josef Gregorian, Undercity).

levelWith.note: Keep the bags for your characters.

learn: Mageweave Bag (10-slot).
Caster pieces your Mage, Priest and Warlock can wear.
skip: Silk and mageweave shirts except Orange Mageweave Shirt when it is cheap.
milestones.mats: About 180 Bolt of Silk Cloth, 180 Bolt of Mageweave, Red Dye, Fine, Silken and Heavy Silken Thread.

milestones.desc: Not tested on the beta yet (level cap). Classic route shown until live data comes in.
learn: Runecloth Bag (14-slot): the best bag for most of the game.
Mooncloth (cooldown): make it every time the cooldown is up. It sells well and is used for end-game gear.
skip: Runecloth armor for selling: most of it is worse than dungeon drops.
milestones.mats: About 500 Runecloth, Rune Thread, Ironweb Spider Silk for some steps.

tips: Data from the WoW Forever beta client (wow-professions.com). Skill ranges changed from Classic: many recipes turn grey about 25 points earlier.

Trainers: Journeyman needs skill 50 and level 10 (capital cities). Expert needs 125, level 20 and 50 silver: Josef Gregorian, Undercity. Artisan needs 200 and level 35: Daryl Stack, Tarren Mill (Hillsbrad).
Two routes from 100: the wool route is cheap; the silk route is faster if you have silk. Mageweave only drops from level 40 mobs.
Every character mails all cloth to the tailor. First Aid also uses cloth, so keep some for bandages.
Camp object: Faction Banner at skill 20.

levelWith.note: Pick the cheaper one on the auction house.

Enchant Boots - Minor Speed if you find the recipe: great for leveling.
skip: Minor Wizard Oil and other oils: low value this early.

milestones.desc: Needs Enchanting 125, character level 20 and 50 silver.
learn: Enchant 2H Weapon - Lesser Impact for the Warrior.
Enchant Boots - Lesser Agility for your Hunter, Rogue and Druid.
skip: Greater Mystic Wand unless a caster still uses a wand.

learn: Enchant Weapon - Crusader: the best leveling and raid enchant for melee. It drops in Western Plaguelands.
Brilliant Wizard Oil and Mana Oil for raids.
skip: Most Greater Resistance enchants unless your raid asks for them.
milestones.mats: About 75 Vision Dust, 212 Dream Dust, 20 Purple Lotus, 20 Crystal Vial, 50 Illusion Dust, Arcanite rod materials.

tips: Data from the WoW Forever beta client (wow-professions.com, checked against your own game data for skill 1-38). Trainer steps are 1-70, 70-150, 150-225 and 225-300.
New in Forever: Mote of Magic. Make it with Dust to Motes: 1 Strange Dust gives 3 Motes. Trainer vendors also sell Motes for levels 1-20.
Every character mails green items to the enchanter to disenchant. Enchanting needs a lot of greens.
You need a rod at each tier: Runed Copper (1), Silver (100), Golden (150), Truesilver (200), Arcanite (294). The rod items come from a blacksmith or a trade vendor.
Artisan (225-300) is taught only by Annora in Uldaman.
Do not vendor dust or essences. They are worth more to enchant with or to sell to players.

Mulgore.class: At level 10, get your pet-taming quest in Bloodhoof Village. Keep 2+ stacks of bullets.
Mulgore.next: At level 10-11, take the road east into The Barrens and go to the Crossroads.

The Barrens.class: Tame a faster-attacking beast here if your first pet feels slow. Train pet skills from beasts you tame.
The Barrens.next: At level ~20, go west to Stonetalon Mountains.

Stonetalon Mountains.next: At level ~25, go back through The Barrens and south to Thousand Needles.

Thousand Needles.next: At level ~30-32, take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale.

Stranglethorn Vale.class: Your pet can hold aggro well here. Use it to split the tiger and panther packs.
Stranglethorn Vale.next: Split this zone in two visits. Go to Arathi Highlands at ~36, come back at ~40.

Arathi Highlands.next: At level ~37, go to The Riverglades: take the road fork from Redridge, or the ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port.

Feralas.next: At level ~48, go to Un'Goro Crater through Tanaris.

Un'Goro Crater.next: At level ~52, go to Western Plaguelands through Undercity.

Western Plaguelands.next: At level ~55, go east to Eastern Plaguelands.

Eastern Plaguelands.class: At level 60, the Rhok'delar bow chain starts in Felwood. It needs an item from the Molten Core raid, so plan it with your raid group.
Eastern Plaguelands.next: Finish the last levels here. At 60, start group and dungeon content.

Durotar.class: At level 10, your Voidwalker quest starts in Orgrimmar (Cleft of Shadow). It may send you into Skull Rock: do only that part, then leave.
Durotar.next: At level ~11, walk west through the Southfury River bridge into The Barrens.

The Barrens.class: Use your Voidwalker to tank. Drain Soul the last mob of a pull to keep 3-5 Soul Shards.
The Barrens.next: At level ~20, go west to Stonetalon Mountains.

Stonetalon Mountains.class: At level 20, get your Succubus quest from the warlock trainer in Orgrimmar.
Stonetalon Mountains.next: At level ~23, go north-east into Ashenvale.

Ashenvale.class: Contested zone. Keep Fear and Death Coil ready for enemy players.
Ashenvale.next: At level ~30, take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale.

Stranglethorn Vale.class: At level 30, get your Felhunter quest from the warlock trainer. Part of it may lead to Desolace, so combine it with that zone.
Stranglethorn Vale.next: At level ~35, fly to Desolace. Come back here at ~40.

Desolace.class: Many demons here. Farm Soul Shards between quests.
Desolace.next: At level ~40, save gold: warlocks learn their mount from the trainer. Then take the ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port in The Riverglades.

Feralas.next: At level ~48, fly to Felwood through Orgrimmar.

Felwood.class: Many demons again. Felcloth drops here: send it to your tailor.
Felwood.next: At level ~52, go to Western Plaguelands through Undercity.

Western Plaguelands.next: At level ~55, go east to Eastern Plaguelands.

Eastern Plaguelands.class: At level 60, the epic mount chain (Dreadsteed) needs a group in Dire Maul. Plan it with friends.

Tirisfal Glades.class: Undead Paladins start in Deathknell with their own quests, for example Rediscovering the Light. From level ~10, your class quests come from Bandarion Keep in the Whispering Wood (Tirisfal).
Tirisfal Glades.next: At level ~11, walk south into Silverpine Forest. The hub is The Sepulcher.

Silverpine Forest.class: Use the slowest two-handed weapon you can get. Seal of Righteousness and Judgement hit harder with it.
Silverpine Forest.next: At level ~16, take the zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar. Walk west and south to the Crossroads.

The Barrens.class: Keep Blessing of Might up. Lay on Hands has a long cooldown: save it for emergencies.
The Barrens.next: At level ~21, take the zeppelin to Undercity. Walk south through Silverpine to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad.

Hillsbrad Foothills.class: Contested zone. Keep Hammer of Justice (a stun) and Divine Protection ready for enemy players.
Hillsbrad Foothills.next: At level ~27, take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar. Go south through The Barrens to Freewind Post.

Thousand Needles.next: At level ~32, take the zeppelin to Undercity. Go east through Hillsbrad to Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

Arathi Highlands.class: At level 40, ask your trainer about a mount. Save gold before you arrive. Forever details for Undead Paladins are not known yet.
Arathi Highlands.next: At level ~37, go to The Riverglades: take the road fork from Redridge, or the ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port.

The Riverglades.next: At level ~44, take the ship to Tanaris. Go west through Thousand Needles to Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Feralas.next: At level ~46, go to Undercity. Walk through Hillsbrad to Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

The Hinterlands.next: At level ~51, walk back west through Hillsbrad and north to The Bulwark in Western Plaguelands.

Western Plaguelands.next: At level ~55, go east to Eastern Plaguelands.

Eastern Plaguelands.class: Most mobs here are Undead. Exorcism and Holy Wrath do extra damage to them.
Eastern Plaguelands.next: At level ~57, go through Tanaris and Un'Goro Crater to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Silithus.next: Finish the last levels here. At 60, start group and dungeon content.

routeNotes.text: Once you have Mining, buy a Mining Pick (10c): in Forever, Mining makes sharpening stones for your two-hand weapon (RestedXP tip).
Bandarion Keep (Whispering Wood, north-west Tirisfal): Paladin class quests start here at about level 10, and you come back for each new one.
Dungeons: at low levels you may be able to tank (Seal of Fury) or heal with some gear. Test it and tell me.
Class mount: quest A Trusty Steed (Forsaken Warhorse).

Tirisfal Glades.class: Buy a wand as soon as you can. Let the wand finish mobs to save mana.
Tirisfal Glades.next: At level ~11, walk south into Silverpine Forest. The hub is The Sepulcher.

Silverpine Forest.class: Pull pattern: Power Word: Shield, Shadow Word: Pain, then wand. Wait 5 seconds after a spell to regain mana faster.
Silverpine Forest.next: At level ~16, take the zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar. Walk west and south to the Crossroads.

The Barrens.class: At level 20, Undead priests learn Devouring Plague. Take Wand Specialization in your talents early.
The Barrens.next: At level ~21, take the zeppelin to Undercity. Walk south through Silverpine to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad.

Hillsbrad Foothills.next: At level ~25, take the zeppelin to Orgrimmar. Go north through The Barrens to Splintertree Post.

Ashenvale.class: Contested zone. Psychic Scream (fear) and Power Word: Shield save you from enemy players.
Ashenvale.next: At level ~30, take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale.

Stranglethorn Vale.class: At level 40, Shadowform (Shadow talents) makes solo play much faster.
Stranglethorn Vale.next: Split this zone in two visits. Go to Arathi Highlands at ~36, come back at ~40.

Arathi Highlands.next: At level ~37, go to The Riverglades: take the road fork from Redridge, or the ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port.

The Riverglades.next: At level ~44, take the ship to Tanaris. Go west through Thousand Needles to Camp Mojache in Feralas.

phases.name: Phase 1: Launch rush
phases.goal: Make the first gold. Everyone levels crafting at the same time, so low-level materials sell high.
do: Bags: levels 1-6 buy no bag materials (skills and professions first, except the 25c gathering bag: buy it as soon as you can; the starting-zone quest gives a free bag). After the level 10 skills, mail the bank character Linen Cloth (6 per bag) and 30c per Linen Bag, plus 1s 30c once for her very first bag (recipe and Tailoring). You decide how many from the bags you already found.
Do not buy bags from a vendor at the start: free quest bags come at the start, in The Barrens (Deviate Hides, 10 slots) and at Skywatcher Plateau (12 slots).
Bags full while questing: vendor when you are back at a quest town anyway. Throw away greys first; keep quest items and materials.
Gatherer: take Skinning and Herbalism. Skin everything you kill. Pick herbs that are on your quest path.
Sell raw materials: Light Leather, Peacebloom, Silverleaf, Earthroot, Copper Ore, Linen Cloth.
Post in small stacks of 5-10. Buyers pay more per item for small stacks.
Post in the evening, when most players are online.

Tailor: craft only what sells at a profit or what your other profession uses (cloth gear to disenchant). Never craft gear just for skill points. Linen Bags: a vendor sells a 6-slot bag for 5s, so they never sell for much more. Make them to sell only when 6 Linen Cloth costs well under 4s 50c (about 70c each); otherwise sell the linen and keep the bags for your own characters. The Money tab shows the real profit.
Enchanter: make Lesser Magic Wands. Casters buy them.
Sell grey items to vendors. Do not keep junk.
avoid: Levelling a crafting profession with bought materials. It burns gold in these weeks.
Buying gear on the auction house, except a big weapon upgrade.
Herb and ore nodes far from your quests on a PvP realm. Enemy players camp them.
Sending many full stacks in one mail on the beta: a bug can lose that mail. Send a few stacks per mail.

phases.name: Phase 2: Settle and save
phases.goal: Save for the level 40 mount. Low-level materials get cheaper as alts farm them.
do: Sell mid-level materials: Wool and Silk Cloth, Medium and Heavy Leather, Bruiseweed, Kingsblood, Liferoot, Iron Ore.
Crafters: buy low-level materials when the Money tab shows Buy (price below your 7-day median).
Level crafting on cheap materials now, not in week 1.
Keep the mount gold separate. Check the mount tracker on the Money tab.
avoid: Selling when the Money tab shows Buy for that item. Wait a few days.
Spending mount gold on gear you will replace in 5 levels.

phases.name: Phase 3: Mount and grow
phases.goal: Buy the mount, then use gold to level all professions fast.
do: Buy the mount the moment you reach the gold goal.
Sell high-level herbs and ore: they feed raid potions and gear. The first raids open on December 9.
Crafters: make items where the Money tab shows a good profit after the auction house cut.
Enchanter: sell dust and essences when their Sell signal shows.

Long term (Legacy perk Dedicated Study): every character with both professions plus Cooking, First Aid and Fishing at 300 makes 2-3 random elemental essences a day. Level Cooking and First Aid on every character as you go; Fishing is the slow one. Essence prices will drop as more players do this, so sell early. (Studen Albatroz video, not checked.)
avoid: Flooding the market: post a few items at a time, not your whole stock.
Undercutting by a lot. Undercut by a copper or a few percent only.

methods.name: Day-one gold: Brown Linen Pants shuffle
methods.source: Method from a WoW Forever beta video (Ceedsy Stream, September 2026), which claimed 13g 25s in 6.5 hours; your own test found far fewer essences than the video.
steps: Orc or Troll: do the Cactus Apple quest early. In Forever it gives an item that lets you skin. Skin every beast, also ones other players left, and sell the Ruined Leather Scraps.
Do the first Durotar quests for about 10 silver of starting money.
Learn Enchanting from Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village (Durotar 56.7, 73.7, new in Forever; QuestieDB) and Tailoring in Orgrimmar.
Buy Linen Cloth only up to 50 copper each. Make Bolts of Linen Cloth until Tailoring 30.
Make Brown Linen Pants and disenchant every pair.
Sell Strange Dust on the auction house. Sell Lesser Magic Essence there too, or make Lesser Magic Wands for the vendor: the card below says which pays more.

Too much Strange Dust? A beta video turns it into Minor Wizard Oil (with a Maple Seed and an Empty Vial) and sells the oil to a vendor for about 3 silver profit per dust. Check the oil recipe and vendor price in game first.
Buy more linen and repeat. Cheap green items (up to about 3 silver) are also worth disenchanting.
At Enchanting 70: Greater Magic Wands sell to a vendor for about 15 silver each.

calc.note: Odds come from your own disenchants (observed in guide.json; tell Claude new results to add them). First test on the beta, 29 Sept: 10 pants gave 12 dust and 1 essence, a small loss at 88c linen. It pays when Linen Cloth is below about 80c.

methods.name: Blacksmith gold: Heavy Copper Mace disenchant
methods.source: From a WoW Forever beta video (Frostadamus, September 2026): 5-7 gold per hour of semi-AFK crafting at level 20. Not tested by you yet.
steps: Learn the Heavy Copper Mace (a level 11 mace; you can make it below Blacksmithing 50). Check its materials in the trainer window: the video says 12 Copper Bars, 2 Light Leather and 2 Weak Flux.
Buy Weak Flux from a blacksmith supplies vendor (about 1 silver each). Use your team's own Copper Ore and Light Leather when you can.
Keep the cost of one mace under 20 silver. Copper Bars at up to about 1s 20c each still pay.
Send the maces to your enchanter and disenchant them: they give mostly 1 or 2 Greater Magic Essence.
Sell the Greater Magic Essence on the auction house, or make Greater Magic Wands (Enchanting 70) for the vendor: compare the prices first.
Mail small: a beta bug loses mail that carries many full stacks. Send a few stacks per mail.

Some places, like towns, instances and contested areas, may not allow camps. On a PvP realm, camp away from roads.

Make a stack of Basic Campfire Kits at home (1 Simple Wood each, from trade vendors) and carry only those: one bag slot.

levelingTips: Dungeon XP changed in Forever: killing dungeon mobs gives less XP, but dungeon quests give more on your first run. Run each dungeon once, with all its quests.
Log out in an inn or a city for rested XP. The Legacy perk Well Rested makes rested XP build faster and cap higher for your alts.
Eat crafted food: Well Fed gives +5% XP from kills for 15 minutes.
Camp Tent (Leatherworking camp object) raises rested XP to 5% per level.
New ship routes: Tanaris to Powderfuse Port (The Riverglades), and Menethil to Southshore to Auberdine.
Leveling speed by class (fan estimate): Mage and Hunter about 8% faster than average; Paladin, Shaman, Warlock and Rogue average; Priest and Druid slower; Warrior about 12% slower.
Expect about 150 hours from 1 to 60: about 20 hours to level 20, 50 hours from 20 to 40, and 80 hours from 40 to 60.

items.text: Reserve 3 names (October 27 to November 3, only 3 allowed): your characters #1 to #3 (the list below).
Pre-download WoW Forever in the Battle.net app. Then tell Claude "launch check".
Make a new Battle.net client secret on develop.battle.net and put it in the .env file (the old one was shown in a chat).

Create all 10 characters right away, so nobody takes the names, in this order (the bank last). If a name is taken, pick a new first name. If the game says creation is throttled (beta: after 9 in a few minutes), wait and try again later.
Run make addon and install the Needed addons from the list below. Restart the game.
Log in each character once, then click Sync.
Run a full Auctionator scan at the auction house once a day.
Check the mount price in game: Apprentice Riding 80 gold at the riding trainer, the mount 20 gold at a mount vendor. Tell Claude if it is different.

steps.text: Run from Camp Narache to Thunder Bluff (through Bloodhoof Village, then north). Stay on the road.
In Thunder Bluff: learn Tailoring (about 10c; only for bags). The bank starts with no money: wait for the first mail with silver.

Bags: after their level 10 skills, characters mail the bank character Linen Cloth (free from mobs, 6 per bag) and 30c per Linen Bag (3 Coarse Thread about 10c each, plus the mail back). Her very first bag costs 1s 30c more, once: the Linen Bag recipe (90c) and learning Tailoring. Make the Bolts of Linen Cloth first: they raise Tailoring to 5. They decide how many.
Check the auction house: what sells, and are there bags for sale. Then a full scan with Auctionator and Sync.
Stand between the bank, the auction house and the mailbox in Thunder Bluff. It shares the Horde auction house with Orgrimmar.
Every day: full scan with Auctionator at the auction house, collect mail, post auctions.

tips: Rested XP builds while a character is logged out in an inn or a city (outside: 4 times slower). It doubles the XP for kills until it is used up.
Full rested XP is 1.5 levels of bonus XP (a little more with Well Rested). It fills in about 10 days in an inn.
Quests do not use it, but most quests are killing, so keep questing while rested.
The first levels go fast anyway: rested XP pays off from about level 6-8. Park a new character in the inn of its next zone.
No fixed rotation needed: when you feel like playing an alt, pick the one with the most rested XP (the card below).
